title: 'Sub judice rule does not cover Baste Duterte's GenCorp statement'

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The sub judice rule does not cover the remarks made by Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte prior to his appearance before the Senate impeachment court, presiding officer and Senator-Judge Francis Escudero said Tuesday. Escudero was referring to a statement released by Mayor Duterte last Tuesday, Sept. 22, where he claimed that he and all other employees of the Davao City government “never had any knowledge” about his sister’s links to GenCorp Industries Inc.
